name: 에이전트
description: 실행 중인 에이전트와 에이전트 정의를 사이드바에 보여 준다. 카드 표면은 없다.

terminalPlugin.label: 터미널 플러그인
terminalPlugin.description: 에이전트 정의가 세션을 여는 터미널 플러그인의 식별자. 새 정의는 이 값을 plugin으로 저장한다.

status.name: agents.definition-dialog.accounts
status.description: The accounts of the definition dialog in the order of their identifiers, each with its cli, its login and the end of the login: login is true or false for the home of a claude or codex account, from claude auth status --json or codex login status, and null for an account without a home; expires is the loginExpiresAt time of claude, or null.

status.name: agents.definition-dialog.login-run
status.description: The open login of the definition dialog: the account, the sign-in address, null before the address comes, and the last state of the sign-in page {url, title, loading, error}, null before the page reports one; null without a login.

element.name: agents.running.row
element.description: One visible row of the running agents tree, as the tree library draws it: a group, a card or a running agent CLI.

element.name: agents.definitions.row
element.description: One visible row of the definitions tree, as the tree library draws it: a group or a definition.

element.name: agents.definitions.add-definition
element.description: The + at the right end of a group row of the definitions tree that opens the dialog that adds a definition to the group.

element.name: agents.group-dialog.name
element.description: The group name field of the group dialog; Enter adds the group.

element.name: agents.group-dialog.add
element.description: The add button of the group dialog that runs agents.group.create with the name field.

element.name: agents.group-dialog.cancel
element.description: The cancel button of the group dialog that closes it without a change.

element.name: agents.definition-dialog.name
element.description: The name field of the definition dialog.

element.name: agents.definition-dialog.account
element.description: The account select of the definition dialog, which lists the accounts of the project.

element.name: agents.definition-dialog.cwd
element.description: The working folder field of the definition dialog, an absolute path.

element.name: agents.definition-dialog.text
element.description: The role text field of the definition dialog.

element.name: agents.definition-dialog.ko
element.description: The Korean role text field of the definition dialog.

element.name: agents.definition-dialog.files
element.description: The role files field of the definition dialog: absolute paths, one per line.

element.name: agents.definition-dialog.save
element.description: The save button of the definition dialog that defines a new definition or changes the stored one.

element.name: agents.definition-dialog.cancel
element.description: The cancel button of the definition dialog that closes it without a change.

element.name: agents.definition-dialog.login
element.description: The login button under the account select of the definition dialog, enabled while the selected account has no login in its home; it runs agents.account.login with the selected account, and is hidden while the login runs.

element.name: agents.definition-dialog.login-cancel
element.description: The button 로그인 취소 that stands in place of the login button while the login runs and runs agents.account.login.cancel.

element.name: agents.definition-dialog.login-page
element.description: The area under the account row of the definition dialog that shows the sign-in page of the open login in the region login; hidden without a sign-in address.

element.name: agents.definition-dialog.account-id
element.description: The identifier field of the new account row of the definition dialog.

element.name: agents.definition-dialog.account-cli
element.description: The cli field of the new account row of the definition dialog, such as claude or codex.

element.name: agents.definition-dialog.account-add
element.description: The add button of the new account row of the definition dialog that runs agents.account.define and selects the new account.

commands.name: agents.group.create
commands.description: Creates an empty group of the project with the given name and returns its identifier. A name that a group of the project already has is refused.

commands.name: agents.definition.define
commands.description: Defines a definition in a group: checks the group, the membership and the account, defines the role with core.role.define, then stores the definition with the plugin of the setting terminalPlugin and adds its identifier to the members of the group. The files are the absolute paths, one per line; cwd is an absolute path. Returns the identifier.

commands.name: agents.definition.change
commands.description: Changes the definition with the identifier, which is a member of the group: checks the group, the membership, the account and the record with the same rules as agents.definition.define, redefines the role with core.role.define under the same identifier, then stores the name, the account and the cwd. The plugin and the maker of the record stay as they are. The files are the absolute paths, one per line; cwd is an absolute path. Returns the identifier.

commands.name: agents.definition.open
commands.description: Opens the definition dialog of the window for the group. Without id the dialog adds a definition to the group; with id it shows the stored definition and its role for changing.

commands.name: agents.definition.remove
commands.description: Removes a definition from a group: removes the role with core.role.remove, then removes the definition and its identifier from the members of the group.

commands.name: agents.running.select
commands.description: Selects the tab of a running agent in the window, the tab that the row of the running agents section names.

commands.name: agents.session.show
commands.description: Shows a session that core.sessions lists as open in the current card of the window, with core.layout.open, so that the tab attaches to the session.

commands.name: agents.account.define
commands.description: Adds the agent account with the identifier, or replaces the account with the same identifier. args holds one argument per entry and env the names of the environment variables that the program receives. An account of claude or codex gets the home folder accounts/<id> of the data folder of the plugin, which is created with mode 0700 before the account is stored, so every project that names the identifier shares its login.

commands.name: agents.account.remove
commands.description: Removes the agent account with the identifier from the project and keeps its home folder, which another project may name. An account that a definition names is refused.

commands.name: agents.account.login
commands.description: Runs the login of the account inside the definition dialog: runs claude auth login or codex login in the home folder of the account, shows the sign-in page in the dialog, and answers when the login ends, after the settings of the person are copied into the home and the login is read again. Opens no tab. Refuses an account without a home and a login that ends with a status other than 0.

commands.name: agents.account.login.cancel
commands.description: Ends the open login of the definition dialog; the login command then ends with cancelled. Without an open login it changes nothing.

commands.name: agents.definition-dialog.sign-in
commands.description: Shows the sign-in address of the open login in the region of the definition dialog. The login program runs it; an address that is not https or a call without an open login is refused.

commands.name: agents.group.open
commands.description: Opens the group dialog of the window, whose add button runs agents.group.create with the name of the group.

commands.name: agents.dialog.cancel
commands.description: Closes the dialog of the calling page without a change.
